jobs.title: Enterprise Risk Management, Technology Strategy Director
jobs.description:
Job Purpose / Overview

The Director, ERM Technology Strategy, is responsible for defining and driving the long-term strategy for technology enablement within the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM). This role provides strategic leadership across the ERM technology landscape, establishing a unified vision for the respective ERM Programs (Stress Testing, Limit Management, Digital Assets & AI, Risk Identification etc.) and associated platform capabilities, ERM Data domain, analytics, and reporting capabilities that support the firm's risk management objectives.

This role leads the development of roadmaps and the vision for the target-state business capabilities. This includes a standardized and consistent operating model for ERM program-related activities performed within each Risk segment and how cross‑segment solution designs are developed. The strategy for ERM will focus on driving portfolio rationalization, simplification, business process integration, and modernization efforts across key capabilities, including Scenario Manager, CST, MEP, MyRisk/ERDL, BCBS-239 reporting and related risk management platforms. The role ensures technology investments are aligned with business priorities, regulatory requirements, and enterprise architecture/data standards while delivering measurable value and operational efficiency.

Working closely with senior leaders across Risk, Finance, Compliance, Technology, Data, and Enterprise Architecture, establishing strategic priorities, oversees product investments, and guides the evolution of the ERM portfolio. The role serves as the primary bridge between business strategy and technology design, ensuring that product management and technology delivery teams are positioned to successfully execute the ERM vision.

This role reports directly to the Head of ERM Technology & Data

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Vision

Define and maintain the enterprise-wide technology strategy for ERM, ensuring alignment with business objectives, regulatory expectations, and the firm's broader technology agenda.
Develop and communicate a clear target-state vision and multi-year roadmap for ERM business capabilities and the underlying platforms, data, analytics, and reporting solutions.
Establish strategic priorities and investment objectives that drive business value, operational efficiency, scalability, resilience, and innovation.
Identify emerging technologies, industry trends, and market opportunities that can enhance enterprise risk management capabilities.

Business Architecture & Portfolio Rationalization

Lead the strategic oversight of the rationalization, simplification and modernization of the ERM technology ecosystem, reducing duplication and improving integration across risk management platforms.
Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Technology teams to influence target-state architectures, integration standards, and technology principles to ensure alignment with business strategy.
Drive strategic business decisions related to solution consolidation, data management, cloud adoption, automation, and advanced analytics capabilities.
Ensure solutions are designed to support scalability, operational resilience, data policy and controls, regulatory compliance, and long-term sustainability.

Product Portfolio Oversight

Provide strategic oversight of the ERM product portfolio (incl. related to the ERM Programs), ensuring alignment between product roadmaps, business priorities, and technology strategy.
Guide Product Management leaders in defining product vision, prioritization frameworks, and investment decisions.
Evaluate and prioritize competing strategic initiatives, balancing risk, value, complexity, cost, and resource considerations.
Establish governance frameworks that ensure consistent decision-making, accountability, regular review and delivery of strategic outcomes.

Stakeholder Management & Business Partnership

Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders across Risk, Finance, Compliance, Technology, and Data organizations.
Build strong partnerships with business stakeholders to understand evolving requirements and translate strategic objectives into technology initiatives.
Lead executive-level discussions and reviews regarding technology strategy, investment priorities, transformation initiatives, and platform modernization efforts.
Drive alignment across diverse stakeholder groups, fostering collaboration and consensus on strategic decisions.

Financial & Investment Management

Working closely with the BoW planning team and oversee strategic technology investment planning for ERM capabilities, ensuring resources are directed toward the highest-value opportunities.
Jointly with ERM Program Leads, Report Owners or System Sponsors/Owners to develop business cases and investment recommendations that clearly articulate expected benefits, risks, and return on investment.
Along with BoW planning team to monitor portfolio performance and value realization to ensure strategic objectives are achieved.

Organizational Leadership

Lead and develop a high-performing team of product management and strategy professionals (currently indirectly reporting team(s)).
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Provide coaching and mentorship to senior leaders and team members across the ERM technology organization.
Champion Agile principles, modern product management practices, and data-driven decision-making.

Expertise & Qualifications

Demonstrated experience developing and executing technology strategy within large, complex organizations.
Strong understanding of enterprise risk management, forecasting methodologies, financial concepts, scenario analysis, and regulatory reporting frameworks.
Significant experience leading business and technology-enabled transformation initiatives and large-scale platform modernization programs.
Strong conceptual understanding of enterprise architecture, data management, technology ecosystems, systems integration, and cloud-based solutions from a business perspective.
Proven ability to align business strategy with technology investments and organizational priorities.
Extensive experience overseeing product portfolios and guiding product management organizations.
Strong financial acumen with experience evaluating investment decisions, business cases, and value realization metrics.
Demonstrated success influencing executive stakeholders and leading through complexity, ambiguity, and organizational change.
Deep understanding of Agile delivery methodologies, product operating models, and modern technology development practices to effectively partner with technology teams.
Exceptional communication, presentation, and executive engagement skills.
Strong strategic thinking and analytical problem-solving capabilities.
Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred.
12+ years of progressive experience in financial services, risk management, finance, analytics, business and technology strategy, product management, or related disciplines, including leadership responsibility for enterprise-scale initiatives.

Leadership Qualities

Enterprise-minded leader capable of balancing strategic vision with practical execution.
Strong influencer who builds alignment across senior executives, business leaders, and technology organizations.
Forward-thinking and innovative, continuously seeking opportunities to improve capabilities and drive business value.
Highly collaborative and effective at leading through partnership rather than authority.
Resilient and adaptable in dynamic, complex, and highly regulated environments.
Strong people leader who develops talent, empowers teams, and fosters a culture of accountability and excellence.
Results-oriented with a demonstrated commitment to delivering measurable outcomes.
Trusted advisor who builds credibility through expertise, transparency, and sound judgment.

Education

Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe
, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Position Description:

As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineering team—it’s core to it.

You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turn technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down.

You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence.

You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing them off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency.

Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards.

You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal.

This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the details.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction.

AI and agentic engineering

Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against.
Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for.
Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed.
Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.

Team, resourcing, and accountability

Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.
Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.
Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows.

Platform and execution

Own the architecture end-to-end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.
Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend.

In the first week, expect to:

Learn Toptal’s model and platform architecture, and meet the leaders you will depend on across Engineering, Product, Industries, and Services.
Establish a direct, working rhythm with the CEO.

In the first month, expect to:

Assess the engineering function honestly, and assess AI maturity with it: what is really in production, what is measured, what is duplicated, and what should be shut down.
Assess the team against the bar this role requires, and bring the executive team a strategy no one asked you for.

In the first three months, expect to:

Be executing your own plan, with a review cadence and clear accountability at every level, and your resourcing plan presented.
Stand up the shared AI architecture and evals, and put one agentic workflow into production with a baseline and a measured result.

In the first six months, expect to:

Show business impact from agents in production in at least two core workflows, with the evidence behind it.
Have the leadership team you need, with the bar visibly raised, and throughput and reliability moving on the paths that matter most.

In the first year, expect to:

Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering.
Have AI leverage embedded in the architecture and the operating model, not living in a portfolio of pilots, and the team you built delivering against plan.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred.
15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale.
Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up.
Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work.
Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence.
Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers.
Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.
You create strategy rather than administer it, and you win arguments on evidence rather than authority, including your view on what a team should look like in the age of AI.
Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, and a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.
Currently hands-on. You read and write code, you can take apart a design document or an eval harness and find the flaw in it, and you command distributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale.
Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield.
Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Speed, ownership, and quality. You move with urgency, decide without perfect information, and treat everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

For Toptal Use Only: #canada #southamerica #europe #easterneurope #northerneurope

jobs.title: Associate Vice-President, Financial Planning & Analysis
jobs.description:
Position Overview

Lambert Nemec Group, Winnipeg's leader in Permanent Accounting & Finance Recruitment, has partnered with our client, a high-growth, Winnipeg-based organization, to recruit a highly analytical and business-savvy Associate Vice-President, Financial Planning & Analysis
. The AVP of FP&A will be responsible for a broad range of responsibilities including but not limited to owning the annual business planning and budgeting cycle, building out forecasting and scenario modelling capabilities, developing performance dashboards and KPIs, and partnering closely with business unit leaders across the organization. This is an exceptional opportunity for a seasoned finance professional who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and is looking for a role with strong visibility to senior leadership, given the exceptional cross-functional exposure this opportunity provides.

Responsibilities

The Associate Vice-President, Financial Planning & Analysis is responsible to:

Administer the annual budgeting cycle and maintain a regular cadence of in-year monthly forecasting.
Oversee financial planning processes and systems across the organization.
Partner with business unit leaders to build and maintain planning models, run scenario analyses, and prepare forecasts.
Analyze and report on financial and operational results to provide senior leadership with insight into business performance.
Develop and maintain dashboards and KPIs, including tracking of variances to plan and progress on cost-saving and revenue initiatives.
Communicate the drivers behind business unit performance and results directly to senior leadership.
Provide detailed analysis and commentary on results, partnering directly with departmental leaders on their numbers.
Evaluate historical budget and spending trends to inform future planning cycles.
Provide insight to senior leadership on financial modelling, forecasting, and profitability.

Requirements

Post-secondary education in accounting, finance, or a related field.
Canadian accounting designation, CPA (CA, CGA, CMA) or CFA required.
5+ years of progressive financial planning & analysis experience, or relevant analytical experience gained within a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Experience working within a larger, multi-divisional organization.
Highly proficient in Excel and business intelligence tools, with experience across enterprise financial systems.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to problem-solve complex issues.
Strong interpersonal and influencing skills, with the ability to communicate effectively and engage with people at all levels across the organization.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and written and verbal communication skills.
Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment with a high tolerance for ambiguity and the ability to manage a large volume of competing priorities.
This is a fully in-office opportunity

Rewards

Opportunity provides exceptional exposure and interaction with senior Finance leadership and cross-functional stakeholders across the business.
Join an organization in an active, high-growth stage, with genuine long-term career growth potential as the finance team continues to scale.
Competative compensation package with an annual Performance Based Bonus Plan
Extended Health & Dental Plan
Professional dues & development

To Apply

Please complete our confidential online registration at www.lambertnemec.com to be considered for this opportunity or send your resume (in Word format) directly to Kyne Hunt, VP of Recruitment and Advisory at kyne@lambertnemec.com quoting Associate Vice-President, Financial Planning & Analysis in the subject.

To view other opportunities currently available, go to https://lambertnemec.com/career-portal/index.html#/jobs

We thank all applicants in advance. However, only those individuals who best meet our client's specifications will be contacted. All other resumes will be kept on file for future consideration.

jobs.title: Director, Solutions Architecture - Enterprise Architecture
jobs.description:
Director, Solutions Architecture – Enterprise Architecture

Fitch Group is seeking a Director, Solutions Architecture based in our Toronto office, reporting to the Lead Enterprise Architect for the Fitch Group line of business you support.
This is a hands-on architecture role built around one core relationship: engineering squads. You'll partner directly with the teams building technology across your line of business, helping them design solutions, navigate architecture standards, and build with confidence. You'll also help build our internal automated governance agents, contributing hands-on to the tools that support technology evaluation, PR review, and standards enforcement across the organization. This is an individual contributor role — no direct reports — for someone who leads through influence, expertise, and relationship.

What We Offer

Direct Engineering Partnership: Serve as the architecture partner engineering squads actually want to talk to — someone who helps them solve real problems, not someone who shows up to gate their work.
Hands-On Contribution to Automated Governance: Build agents alongside the EA team — PR review, ARB submission support, technology evaluation — using your own experience with agent orchestration, observability, and MCP tooling.
Influence Without Bureaucracy: Shape how engineering teams adopt architecture patterns through demonstrated value, not mandate. You earn trust by being useful.
AI-Native Engineering at Scale: Help define how an entire line of business builds software with AI — from coding assistants to agentic development workflows — and set the practices other teams follow.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Be the Architect Engineers Call First: Provide direct architecture guidance to the engineering squads in your line of business — solution design, trade-off analysis, pattern selection — in the flow of their actual work.
Support ARB and JAD Sessions When It Matters: Step in to help squads prepare when a new technology or a new pattern is entering the picture — pressure-testing the design and reducing back-and-forth before formal review.
Build Agents for the EA Lifecycle: Contribute directly to the agents that power technology evaluation, PR review, standards enforcement, and ARB submission support.
Translate Standards Into Practice: Take architecture principles and the Tech Roadmap (Invest/Maintain/Divest/Research) and make them concrete and actionable for engineers building real systems.
Prototype Before You Recommend: Build working examples of patterns before asking teams to adopt them. Credibility here comes from having built it yourself.
Partner Across Engineering: Work closely with engineering leads to understand their constraints and tailor architecture guidance to their specific context — what works for one squad won't work for all of them.
Champion AI-Based Development: Help squads adopt AI-assisted and agentic development — coding assistants, AI-driven testing, and agentic workflows — and establish the patterns, guardrails, and metrics that let them ship faster with confidence rather than treating AI as a novelty.
Drive Down Technical Liabilities: Use the Tech Roadmap (Invest/Maintain/Divest/Research) and the enterprise architecture graph of dependencies to give squads a clear view of their technical debt — what to retire, what to modernize, and where hidden coupling creates risk before it becomes an incident.
Automate Upgrades and Modernization: Help teams stand up automated dependency upgrades, patching, and modernization pipelines — so keeping systems current becomes a routine, low-effort habit instead of a stop-the-world project.
Own Reference Architectures and Reference Code: Create, curate, and maintain reusable reference architectures and a well-documented reference code base that squads can build from — raising the bar on consistency, quality, and speed across your line of business.

What You Need To Have

Deep Technical Architecture Experience: A strong record designing and evolving backend/distributed systems architecture, including data modeling and event-driven design, and ideally schema governance, API design, or platform-scale technical standards.
Hands-On Agentic AI Experience: Real experience building AI agents, working with LLMs, and applying agentic patterns — orchestration, observability, tool use — to production workflows.
Influence-Based Leadership: Demonstrated ability to drive adoption across teams without direct authority — earning buy-in through trust and results, not org-chart power.
Customer-Facing Orientation: You think of engineers as your customers. You want to understand their problems and help solve them, not enforce a checklist.
Governance at Scale: Experience defining and evolving technical standards across many teams — knowing how to get consistent buy-in without slowing everyone down.
Track Record Driving AI Adoption: Demonstrated success introducing AI-based development practices — coding assistants, agentic workflows, or developer-productivity tooling — to engineering teams and getting real, sustained usage rather than shelfware.
Technical Debt and Dependency Management: Experience mapping system dependencies and leading modernization or automated-upgrade programs across a codebase or platform.

What Would Make You Stand Out

MCP and Agent Tooling Experience: Hands-on work building tools that let AI agents discover, query, or act on internal systems.
LLM Observability: Experience standing up or operating observability platforms for LLM agents — traces, cost, safety evaluation.
Cross-Team Schema or API Governance: Experience leading standards work across a large number of engineering teams.
Technical Leadership Through Expertise: A track record of being the go-to technical voice on a team — mentoring and shaping direction through credibility, not title.

Why Choose Fitch:

Hybrid Work Environment: 2 to 3 days a week in office required based on your line of business and location
A Culture of Learning & Mobility: Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity
Investing in Your Future: Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals
Promoting Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing
Supportive Parenting Policies: Family-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
Inclusive Work Environment: A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe
Dedication to Giving Back: Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community

Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch’s credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interest or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will be asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work.
Fitch is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law.

FOR Toronto ROLES ONLY: Expected base pay rates for the role will be between 225,000 and 275,000 CAD per year. Actual salaries will be determined on an individualized basis and may vary based on factors including but not limited to education, training, experience, past performance, and other job-related factors. Base pay is one part of Fitch’s total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, discretionary bonuses, long-term incentives, and other benefits sponsored by Fitch.

jobs.title: Director of Finance & Controller
jobs.description:
Controller & Director of Finance – Path to VP Finance Progressive Industrial Fluids Ltd.

London, Ontario | On-Site | Full-Time, Permanent

Compensation:
$130,000–$140,000+ base, depending on experience, plus performance-based incentive
Lead Finance Today. Grow Into VP Finance. Progressive Industrial Fluids is looking for an exceptional Controller & Director of Finance to take immediate leadership of our accounting and finance department and help build the financial infrastructure required for our next stage of growth.
This is more than a traditional Controller role.
We need someone who can lead the department today: strengthen accounting processes and controls, improve reporting, develop the team and provide leadership with reliable financial information for better decision-making.
For the right person, this role also offers a clear opportunity to progress into VP Finance.
A candidate who demonstrates strong leadership, delivers meaningful improvements, aligns with our organization and proves capable of operating at an executive level will have the opportunity to advance into the VP Finance role and earn a seat on our Executive Leadership Team.
About Progressive Industrial Fluids Progressive Industrial Fluids is a Canadian-owned manufacturer of specialty lubricants, metalworking fluids, stamping compounds and industrial chemical solutions. For nearly two decades, we have helped manufacturers improve processes, lower total operating costs and solve challenging production problems.
We have invested significantly in the foundation for our next stage of growth, including:
Modern ERP infrastructure through Odoo
Expanded manufacturing capabilities
In-house laboratory and technical services
Improved processes, workflows, costing and operational data
An established industrial customer base
A strategy to expand our Canadian business and enter key U.S. manufacturing markets

We now need a finance leader who can strengthen the department we have today while helping design the financial organization we will need tomorrow.
Your Initial Mandate You will become the senior internal leader of our accounting and finance function and work directly with ownership and senior leadership.
Your immediate priorities will include:
Leading and developing the accounting and finance team
Strengthening month-end and year-end processes
Improving financial reporting and management visibility
Establishing stronger controls and accountability
Improving budgeting, forecasting and cash-flow management
Strengthening product costing, inventory and margin analysis
Improving ERP data integrity and financial processes
Clarifying roles and responsibilities within the department
Identifying financial risks, weaknesses and opportunities
Creating a practical roadmap for the finance function

We want someone who can quickly understand where we are, determine what needs improvement and turn that assessment into action.
Path to VP Finance We are deliberately creating this role with room to grow.
You do not need to already hold a VP title. You may currently be a:
Director of Finance
Senior or Corporate Controller
Plant Controller
Divisional Finance Leader
Experienced Finance Manager ready for a larger mandate

Your current title matters less than what you have accomplished and what you are capable of building.
To progress toward VP Finance, you will need to demonstrate the ability to:
Lead the finance department effectively
Build trust with ownership and senior leadership
Develop people and create accountability
Identify risks before they become problems
Turn financial information into business decisions
Improve systems without creating unnecessary bureaucracy
Understand both the financial and operational sides of the business
Help prepare Progressive financially for significant growth

Financial & Operational Leadership As the role develops, your responsibility will extend well beyond accounting.
You will help us answer questions such as:
How much capital will our growth require?
How should we finance inventory and working capital as we scale?
Which customers, products and markets generate the strongest returns?
Where are we deploying capital effectively?
What systems and controls will we need at twice our current size?
How do we pursue aggressive growth without losing financial discipline?

Key areas of responsibility will include:
Cash-flow forecasting and working-capital management
Inventory investment and cash-conversion analysis
Accounts receivable and accounts payable strategy
Banking, lender reporting and financing requirements
Capital expenditure analysis
Budgeting, rolling forecasts and financial modelling
Raw-material, labour and manufacturing overhead analysis
Product costing and gross-margin performance
Customer and product-line profitability
KPI development and management reporting
Growth scenarios and capital planning

Our finance leader must be willing to understand how the business actually operates. You should be comfortable moving between the financial statements and the plant floor.
ERP, Systems & Data Our ERP platform is Odoo. Specific Odoo experience is an asset but is not required. What matters is your ability to understand ERP systems, improve data integrity, develop meaningful reporting and ensure technology gives management better information while reducing unnecessary administrative work.
Build the Finance Team We are not looking for someone who simply performs the work themselves. You will be expected to lead and mentor accounting and finance employees, establish clear expectations, improve accountability, identify skill or resource gaps and build a finance organization capable of supporting growth.
Who We're Looking For You should bring:
Progressive accounting and financial leadership experience
Strong manufacturing finance experience
Strong knowledge of financial statements and accounting controls
Experience leading month-end and year-end processes
Strong understanding of working capital, inventory and cash flow
Cost-accounting and margin-analysis capabilities
Experience with budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling
Experience with banks, lenders and external financial partners
Strong ERP and data-analysis capabilities
Experience improving financial systems and controls
The ability to communicate financial information to non-financial leaders
Demonstrated leadership of accounting or finance professionals

A CPA designation is strongly preferred, but accomplishments, leadership ability and manufacturing experience will carry significant weight.
The Person We're Looking For You are not looking for a comfortable accounting job. You want to build something.
You ask why, challenge assumptions constructively and recognize problems before they become crises. You can move between a detailed costing issue and a long-term strategic discussion.
You are comfortable respectfully challenging leadership when the numbers support your position, and you believe financial discipline should enable growth rather than prevent it.
Most importantly, you want your work to have a visible impact on the company you help build.
What Success Looks Like During your first 12–18 months, we expect measurable progress in:
Monthly and year-end financial reporting
Forecasting and cash management
Financial controls and accountability
Product and customer profitability analysis
Working-capital and inventory management

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management – Developer & AI
jobs.description:
1Password is growing.
We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

The Senior Director of Product Management for Developer & AI will lead product strategy and execution across one of 1Password’s most future-defining portfolios. This role spans our Developer Experience (DevX) products, Security for AI, and AI for Security initiatives, as well as the product surface area that supports standards adoption and developer engagement.

Reporting to the VP of Developer & AI Engineering, this leader will be responsible for defining the product vision, roadmap, and outcomes for how developers and AI-powered systems securely interact with 1Password—from local development and secrets management, to programmatic agent access, to secure runtime environments.

This role requires deep partnership with engineering, design, marketing, partnerships, and GTM teams, and leadership of a senior group of product managers operating across highly technical, platform-oriented problem spaces.

How We’re Using AI Today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What We're Looking For

10+ years in product management, including 5+ years leading senior PMs or product portfolios.
Experience owning platform, developer-facing, or infrastructure products strongly preferred.
Track record of shipping impactful developer tools, platforms, or security products used by large or fast-growing audiences.
Strong familiarity with the modern AI landscape, including LLMs, orchestration frameworks, and agentic workflows.
Ability to reason about AI capabilities and limitations through a product and customer lens.
Solid understanding of modern security concepts such as identity, secrets management, access control, and secure system design.
Comfort operating in highly technical problem spaces alongside senior engineers.
Ability to connect long-term product vision with near-term priorities and measurable outcomes.
Experience balancing discovery, delivery, and platform investment.
Demonstrated success partnering deeply with engineering, design, marketing, and external stakeholders.
Strong communication skills with the ability to influence without authority.

What You Can Expect

Set and evolve the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for 1Password’s Developer Experience, AI security, and AI-powered security initiatives.
Ensure clear articulation of customer problems, value propositions, and success metrics across the portfolio.
Lead product definition for secure, agentic workflows including identity, delegation, secrets delivery, and access control for both developers and AI agents.
Translate emerging AI capabilities and risks into durable, differentiated product primitives.
Work in lockstep with the VP of Developer & AI Engineering to align product strategy with technical vision, architecture, and delivery.
Enable strong product-engineering collaboration that balances innovation, speed, and long-term platform integrity.
Partner with Marketing, Partnerships, Security, and GTM teams to ensure successful launches, platform integrations, and ecosystem adoption.
Represent product strategy internally and externally, ensuring consistency across messaging, documentation, and developer engagement.
Provide product leadership and input into standards participation and developer advocacy efforts, ensuring standards work is grounded in real customer needs and product direction.
Help position 1Password as a trusted product leader in the AI and security ecosystem.
Recruit, mentor, and lead senior product managers working across complex, technical domains.
Establish product operating rhythms, decision-making frameworks, and outcome-oriented metrics.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $267,000 USD and $401,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $248,000 CAD and $372,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How We Work With AI

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work

We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What We Offer

We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing

👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs

🩺 Competitive health benefits

🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future

Community

🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly

🌎 Remote-first work environment

Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

new_jobs.title: Director, Solutions Architecture - Enterprise Architecture
new_jobs.description:
Director, Solutions Architecture – Enterprise Architecture

Fitch Group is seeking a Director, Solutions Architecture based in our Toronto office, reporting to the Lead Enterprise Architect for the Fitch Group line of business you support.
This is a hands-on architecture role built around one core relationship: engineering squads. You'll partner directly with the teams building technology across your line of business, helping them design solutions, navigate architecture standards, and build with confidence. You'll also help build our internal automated governance agents, contributing hands-on to the tools that support technology evaluation, PR review, and standards enforcement across the organization. This is an individual contributor role — no direct reports — for someone who leads through influence, expertise, and relationship.

What We Offer

Direct Engineering Partnership: Serve as the architecture partner engineering squads actually want to talk to — someone who helps them solve real problems, not someone who shows up to gate their work.
Hands-On Contribution to Automated Governance: Build agents alongside the EA team — PR review, ARB submission support, technology evaluation — using your own experience with agent orchestration, observability, and MCP tooling.
Influence Without Bureaucracy: Shape how engineering teams adopt architecture patterns through demonstrated value, not mandate. You earn trust by being useful.
AI-Native Engineering at Scale: Help define how an entire line of business builds software with AI — from coding assistants to agentic development workflows — and set the practices other teams follow.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Be the Architect Engineers Call First: Provide direct architecture guidance to the engineering squads in your line of business — solution design, trade-off analysis, pattern selection — in the flow of their actual work.
Support ARB and JAD Sessions When It Matters: Step in to help squads prepare when a new technology or a new pattern is entering the picture — pressure-testing the design and reducing back-and-forth before formal review.
Build Agents for the EA Lifecycle: Contribute directly to the agents that power technology evaluation, PR review, standards enforcement, and ARB submission support.
Translate Standards Into Practice: Take architecture principles and the Tech Roadmap (Invest/Maintain/Divest/Research) and make them concrete and actionable for engineers building real systems.
Prototype Before You Recommend: Build working examples of patterns before asking teams to adopt them. Credibility here comes from having built it yourself.
Partner Across Engineering: Work closely with engineering leads to understand their constraints and tailor architecture guidance to their specific context — what works for one squad won't work for all of them.
Champion AI-Based Development: Help squads adopt AI-assisted and agentic development — coding assistants, AI-driven testing, and agentic workflows — and establish the patterns, guardrails, and metrics that let them ship faster with confidence rather than treating AI as a novelty.
Drive Down Technical Liabilities: Use the Tech Roadmap (Invest/Maintain/Divest/Research) and the enterprise architecture graph of dependencies to give squads a clear view of their technical debt — what to retire, what to modernize, and where hidden coupling creates risk before it becomes an incident.
Automate Upgrades and Modernization: Help teams stand up automated dependency upgrades, patching, and modernization pipelines — so keeping systems current becomes a routine, low-effort habit instead of a stop-the-world project.
Own Reference Architectures and Reference Code: Create, curate, and maintain reusable reference architectures and a well-documented reference code base that squads can build from — raising the bar on consistency, quality, and speed across your line of business.

What You Need To Have

Deep Technical Architecture Experience: A strong record designing and evolving backend/distributed systems architecture, including data modeling and event-driven design, and ideally schema governance, API design, or platform-scale technical standards.
Hands-On Agentic AI Experience: Real experience building AI agents, working with LLMs, and applying agentic patterns — orchestration, observability, tool use — to production workflows.
Influence-Based Leadership: Demonstrated ability to drive adoption across teams without direct authority — earning buy-in through trust and results, not org-chart power.
Customer-Facing Orientation: You think of engineers as your customers. You want to understand their problems and help solve them, not enforce a checklist.
Governance at Scale: Experience defining and evolving technical standards across many teams — knowing how to get consistent buy-in without slowing everyone down.
Track Record Driving AI Adoption: Demonstrated success introducing AI-based development practices — coding assistants, agentic workflows, or developer-productivity tooling — to engineering teams and getting real, sustained usage rather than shelfware.
Technical Debt and Dependency Management: Experience mapping system dependencies and leading modernization or automated-upgrade programs across a codebase or platform.

What Would Make You Stand Out

MCP and Agent Tooling Experience: Hands-on work building tools that let AI agents discover, query, or act on internal systems.
LLM Observability: Experience standing up or operating observability platforms for LLM agents — traces, cost, safety evaluation.
Cross-Team Schema or API Governance: Experience leading standards work across a large number of engineering teams.

new_jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management – Developer & AI
new_jobs.description:
1Password is growing.
We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

The Senior Director of Product Management for Developer & AI will lead product strategy and execution across one of 1Password’s most future-defining portfolios. This role spans our Developer Experience (DevX) products, Security for AI, and AI for Security initiatives, as well as the product surface area that supports standards adoption and developer engagement.

Reporting to the VP of Developer & AI Engineering, this leader will be responsible for defining the product vision, roadmap, and outcomes for how developers and AI-powered systems securely interact with 1Password—from local development and secrets management, to programmatic agent access, to secure runtime environments.

This role requires deep partnership with engineering, design, marketing, partnerships, and GTM teams, and leadership of a senior group of product managers operating across highly technical, platform-oriented problem spaces.

How We’re Using AI Today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What We're Looking For

10+ years in product management, including 5+ years leading senior PMs or product portfolios.
Experience owning platform, developer-facing, or infrastructure products strongly preferred.
Track record of shipping impactful developer tools, platforms, or security products used by large or fast-growing audiences.
Strong familiarity with the modern AI landscape, including LLMs, orchestration frameworks, and agentic workflows.
Ability to reason about AI capabilities and limitations through a product and customer lens.
Solid understanding of modern security concepts such as identity, secrets management, access control, and secure system design.
Comfort operating in highly technical problem spaces alongside senior engineers.
Ability to connect long-term product vision with near-term priorities and measurable outcomes.
Experience balancing discovery, delivery, and platform investment.
Demonstrated success partnering deeply with engineering, design, marketing, and external stakeholders.
Strong communication skills with the ability to influence without authority.

What You Can Expect

Set and evolve the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for 1Password’s Developer Experience, AI security, and AI-powered security initiatives.
Ensure clear articulation of customer problems, value propositions, and success metrics across the portfolio.
Lead product definition for secure, agentic workflows including identity, delegation, secrets delivery, and access control for both developers and AI agents.
Translate emerging AI capabilities and risks into durable, differentiated product primitives.
Work in lockstep with the VP of Developer & AI Engineering to align product strategy with technical vision, architecture, and delivery.
Enable strong product-engineering collaboration that balances innovation, speed, and long-term platform integrity.
Partner with Marketing, Partnerships, Security, and GTM teams to ensure successful launches, platform integrations, and ecosystem adoption.
Represent product strategy internally and externally, ensuring consistency across messaging, documentation, and developer engagement.
Provide product leadership and input into standards participation and developer advocacy efforts, ensuring standards work is grounded in real customer needs and product direction.
Help position 1Password as a trusted product leader in the AI and security ecosystem.
Recruit, mentor, and lead senior product managers working across complex, technical domains.
Establish product operating rhythms, decision-making frameworks, and outcome-oriented metrics.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $267,000 USD and $401,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $248,000 CAD and $372,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How We Work With AI

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work

We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What We Offer

We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing

👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs

🩺 Competitive health benefits

🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future

📈 RSU program for most employees

💸 Retirement matching program

🔑 Free 1Password account

Community

🤝 Paid volunteer days

🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly

🌎 Remote-first work environment

Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

new_jobs.title: Director, Retirement Strategy
new_jobs.description:
Global Wealth & Asset Management is a key growth segment for Manulife, operating across Retail, Wealth, Retirement and Institutional channels in North America, Asia and Europe. The Director, Retirement Strategy will help shape the growth and transformation agenda for the U.S. and Canada Retirement businesses, translating strategic objectives into actionable priorities and quality execution. By strengthening connectivity between Retirement, Wealth and broader Manulife capabilities, this role will support our mission to make decisions easier and lives better for our customers. This high-profile opportunity provides broad exposure to senior leaders, complex strategic priorities and enterprise-wide initiatives, while enabling the successful candidate to build deep expertise and influence the future of GWAM.

Position Responsibilities

Shape and advance the strategic agenda for the U.S. and Canada Retirement businesses by identifying growth opportunities, strategic risks and value-creation initiatives.
Develop strategies that strengthen the Retirement businesses and deepen connectivity with Wealth and broader Manulife capabilities.
Translate strategic objectives into clear priorities, align discretionary spending with those priorities and support business readiness for execution.
Partner across GWAM, Finance, Transformation and Business Operations to drive cross-functional collaboration, monitor delivery and recommend interventions or pivots where required.
Apply competitive and market intelligence to ensure strategic goals are aspirational, achievable and responsive to industry dynamics.
Develop clear, decision-oriented materials for the Board of Directors, Executive Leadership Team, Transformation Delivery Team and other senior audiences.
Lead strategic projects and support other GWAM priorities as business needs evolve.

Required Qualifications

8–10 years of relevant, progressively senior experience in strategy, transformation, financial services or a related field.
Strong business, strategic, critical and analytical thinking, with the ability to translate complex issues into practical solutions.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence and drive collaboration, accountability and innovation in a matrixed organization.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, exercise sound judgment and deliver results in a dynamic environment.
Superior written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing materials for senior executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in wealth and asset management, retirement or broader financial services.
Experience developing and executing growth, transformation or enterprise strategies.
Understanding of the U.S. and Canadian retirement markets, competitive dynamics and industry trends.
Experience partnering with Finance, Transformation and Business Operations teams to monitor execution and outcomes.
Experience developing Board, Executive Leadership Team or other senior management presentations.

When You Join Our Team

We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.
As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.
